subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — integration tasks & close timeline
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@novaco.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — integration tasks & close timeline

Hi Sara,

Linking the weekly MAP checkpoint notes for Novaco (attached MAP_v3.xlsx). Wanted to call out the engineering checklist items we promised to track this sprint so we can align on close timing:

- SDK integration: sample client, init/auth, and upsert calls (owner: Dev)
- API auth: short-lived token flow + refresh (owner: Dev)
- Streaming: server-streaming demo, reconnect behavior (owner: Marissa)
- Tool calling: example tool schema + invocation guardrails (owner: Dylan)

Requested close window still looks like end of March if we can complete SDK + auth and validate streaming in staging by 3/20. Can you confirm priorities on your side and whether Novaco Legal needs anything queued on the contract front this week?

Action items I propose for this week (see attached integration-checklist.pdf):
1) Dev: produce SDK quickstart and sample repo — due 2026-02-19
2) Marissa: streaming smoke test notes & recon plan — due 2026-02-20
3) Dylan: draft tool-calling examples and prompt templates — due 2026-02-20
4) Novaco: provide list of production IP ranges & required retention window — due 2026-02-22

Attaching: MAP_v3.xlsx, integration-checklist.pdf.

Thanks —
Dylan
Dylan Brooks | Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@novaco.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Lee <michael.lee@novaco.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-16T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — integration tasks & close timeline

Thanks, Dylan —

Quick confirmations from our side:
- Priority is SDK + auth first. We want a working SDK by 3/1 so our platform team can start sandboxing.
- Streaming is important but can be validated in parallel; if streaming proves flaky we can plan for a degraded roll (non-streaming fallback).
- Legal flagged a single item: standard data processing appendix language. They will get back by EOD 2/19.

Two asks for your owners:
- Can Dev include a small section in the quickstart about service account vs. user tokens? We need to validate server-to-server patterns.
- For tool calling, we want one canonical example: a CRM lookup flow (name/email => account lookup) so our product folks can map it to existing microservices.

I'll confirm IP ranges by 2/22.

Best,
Sara
Senior Product Manager, Novaco

Received — I'll start the SDK quickstart this week. Notes:
- Will include both service-account and user-token patterns.
- Plan: draft repo with examples (Python + Node) + CI that runs auth flow against our sandbox.
- Will add an /examples/crm_lookup sample for the tool-calling scenario.

Proposed checklist updates (quick summary):
- 2/19: initial quickstart repo + README (internal demo)
- 2/24: publish public sample repo + versioned SDK package (alpha)
- 3/05: SDK stabilization and integration tests passing in Novaco staging

Attachment: auth-flow-diagram.png (auth sequence and token lifetimes).

Will ping when the repo is up.

— Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@novaco.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — integration tasks & close timeline

Streaming smoke test plan below (short):
- Objective: verify server-streaming stability with 2 concurrent clients and 1 long-lived connection (30s), validate KV caching behavior, and recon on disconnect.
- Steps: 1) run streaming load with sample prompts (see integration-checklist.pdf), 2) measure latency P50/P95 and token throughput, 3) validate reconnect within 5s, 4) confirm message ordering.
- Test infra: staging cluster in us-west-2, tenant sandbox for Novaco.

Deliverables: smoke test notes + logs (due 2/20). If streaming shows packet loss >1% we'll propose either jitter buffer tweaks or fallback to short-poll polling for non-critical features.

I'll add concrete commands to the Drive doc and ping when done.

— Marissa
Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Quick update after internal sync:
- Dev posted initial SDK quickstart (private repo link in Drive).
- Marissa started streaming checks; initial run looks healthy but collecting P95s before we share.
- I drafted CRM lookup example and will push it to the sample folder by EOD.

Open items to escalate to Rafael (pricing/legal):
- Novaco asked for a committed latency SLO for streaming requests in production (they want a number for procurement). Rafael, can you surface standard SLO language and whether a one-off SLA is feasible for this deal?
- Contract appendix: Novaco Legal will send language; I'd like Rafael to be on the thread when it arrives.

I'll compile the weekly checkpoint summary for your execs and share on Monday.

Thanks —
Dylan
